text:
maria.chen: quick q — acme sec questionnaire due EOD Fri. They ask: 'Do logs contain customer PII? list of subprocessors with access to logs? data flow diagram for logging pipeline?' Can we get short answers + owner?

samir: who is owning the response? I can grab the subprocessors list and access levels.

maria.chen: thanks — want short bullets. main points: logs are minimized and redacted at ingestion; we rotate KMS keys; subprocessors: Datadog (read-only logs), AWS S3 (storage, encrypted), DataRelay (partner — needs legal ok for log access). Also mention SOC2 controls.

leo_k: for the 'contain PII?' question we should say: 'we avoid storing customer PII; any PII included is redacted at ingestion using field-level rules.' we should attach a sanitized config snippet.

maria.chen: exactly. can we paste the redaction config from staging (sanitized)? cc @emily_legal for DataRelay approval.

samir: I can export a sanitized config. @ops-oncall can you create a time-limited read-only viewer for the dataflow diagram? Acme asked to see the flow.

ops-oncall: yes — I can publish a viewer link that expires. Will also open a tech ticket to record who has access to logs.

security-bot: Reminder: log retention and access must follow SOC2 controls. See https://docs.redwood/internal/security/logging#redaction for the standard wording.

jordan_t: Legal has previously signed DataRelay for telemetry ingestion, but we need the SOW copy and latest DPA. Pinged @emily_legal.

maria.chen: short deliverables for the questionnaire: 1) one-paragraph answer about PII/redaction 2) list of subprocessors with access level (read/admin/none) 3) dataflow diagram link 4) sanitized redaction rules snippet.

leo_k: here's a small sanitized snippet you can attach (paste into the response):

```json
// redaction_rules.json (sanitized)
[
  {"field": "customer_input", "type": "pii", "action": "mask", "mask_with": "[REDACTED]"},
  {"field": "email", "type": "email", "action": "remove"},
  {"field": "credit_card", "type": "cc", "action": "drop"}
]
```

samir: nice. for the audit path show: ingestion -> redactor -> kafka (kms) -> s3 (kms, encrypted) -> analytics (VPC). I can draw a tiny ascii diagram for the questionnaire.

samir: ingestion -> redactor -> kafka(kms) -> s3(kms) -> analytics(vpc)

maria.chen: perfect. @leo_k can you attach the sanitized config to the security ticket? I'll draft answers and drop them in the ticket for review.

leo_k: done — attached to ticket SEC-4821 and shared a sanitized confluence page (viewer-only). link: https://confluence.redwood/s/SEC-4821-sanitized (sanitized link).

ops-oncall: dataflow viewer link created: https://drawio.redwood/view/abcd (expires in 72h). Created temporary wiki share for acme sec team.

jordan_t: legal — @emily_legal can you confirm DataRelay subprocessor approval and attach SOW/DPA?

emily_legal: saw this. we'll attach the SOW and DPA to SEC-4821. ETA EOD tomorrow.

maria.chen: :thumbsup: thanks everyone. I'll compile and send back to acme once legal confirms. If anyone wants to add specific SOC2 control IDs (e.g., CC6, CC7) or suggest wording, add to the ticket.

samir: I'll add a note referencing CC6.

leo_k: added a short blurb about the redaction step and retention windows to the ticket.

maria.chen: awesome — closing loop here. final send will include: bullets, sanitized config, dataflow link, subprocessors list, legal attachments.

ops-oncall: created the audit log of who viewed the diagram and attached it to SEC-4821 for traceability.

maria.chen: great. thx all :pray:
